# dokploy_redirect (Data Source)

Looks up a Traefik regex redirect of an application that already exists in Dokploy:

```terraform
data "dokploy_redirect" "old" {
  application_id = data.dokploy_application.web.id
  regex          = "^/old/(.*)"
}
```

~> Dokploy does not enforce uniqueness for this record. If two redirect records match the lookup attributes, this data source fails instead of a guess. Look the record up by `id` in that case.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokploy_redirect" "example" {
  id = "your-redirect-id"
}

data "dokploy_redirect" "old" {
  application_id = data.dokploy_application.web.id
  regex          = "^/old/(.*)"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Id of the application that owns the redirect. Set it with `regex`.
- `id` (String) Redirect id. Set it for a lookup by id, or leave it unset and set `application_id` with the distinguishing attributes.
- `regex` (String) Path regex that the redirect matches, for example `^/old/(.*)`.

### Read-Only

- `permanent` (Boolean) Whether the redirect is permanent (308) instead of temporary (307).
- `replacement` (String) Replacement path.
